text:
sophia: Morning folks, I just finished SSO and trying to use kubectl but getting a permissions error when accessing the team's namespace (redwood-dev). Can someone point me to the right access flow?

it-ops: welcome! :wave: what does `kubectl config current-context` show? also which email did you sign up with so we can check the SSO mapping.

sophia: current-context is `redwood-gke-us-central1` and I signed up as sophia@redwood.ai. I can list namespaces but `kubectl get pods -n redwood-dev` returns `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden`.

jamal: that's RBAC. For new hires we either add you to the team AD group or create a short-lived service account kubeconfig scoped to the namespace. Which would you prefer? Token SA is usually faster.

maria: fyi the team namespace is `teams/maria-products` (alias redwood-dev). We allow pod logs and port-forward in dev, but not exec to prod pods. Adding to `devs-maria` group is fine longer-term.

it-ops: runbook summary: 1) verify identity 2) create ServiceAccount + Role limited to the namespace 3) RoleBinding SA -> Role 4) mint kubeconfig with token and share via onboarding ticket. Example Role we use:

```
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: dev-ops-lite
  namespace: teams/maria-products
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","pods/log","services"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create"]
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods/portforward"]
  verbs: ["create"]
```

jamal: I can create `onboarding-sophia` SA and the binding now. Token will expire in 7 days. Do you want me to also set the kubeconfig context to default to the namespace for you?

sophia: please set the context too. Also will port-forward to localhost:3000 work with that?

maria: yes, port-forwarding svc/dev-server 3000:80 should work. Make sure you don't have something using 3000 locally.

onboard-bot: Ticket ONB-482 created for sophia kube access, assigned to jamal, ETA 2 hours.

jamal: done — created SA `onboarding-sophia`, Role, and RoleBinding. Uploaded kubeconfig to the ticket. Token is temporary (7d). Steps I ran: `kubectl create sa onboarding-sophia -n teams/maria-products`, created Role, RoleBinding, then `kubectl -n teams/maria-products get secret $(kubectl -n teams/maria-products get sa onboarding-sophia -o jsonpath='{.secrets[0].name}') -o jsonpath='{.data.token}' | base64 -d` to fetch the token and put it in the kubeconfig.

sophia: confirmed — I can `kubectl get pods -n teams/maria-products` and port-forwarding works. Thanks! :tada:

maria: welcome aboard, sophia. Ping me for app creds or env vars.

it-ops: note added to runbook: prefer ephemeral SA kubeconfigs for first-week access to ease auditing.
